plotEn:
God Laughs (Italian: Dio ride) is a 2026 Italian period comedy-drama film co-written and directed by Giovanni Veronesi. It stars Pierfrancesco Favino, Silvio Orlando, Alma Noce and  Francesco Gheghi.
The film had its world premiere as the closing film of the 83rd Venice International Film Festival on 12 September 2026. It was theatrically released by PiperFilm on 29 October.
